user.title: Skywatch
user.description: Where you are standing, and how far away an aircraft can still be worth looking at.

data.details: Look up aircraft type, airline and route

data_description.location: Drag the marker to where you go outside and stretch the circle to how far you want to watch. Sixty kilometres catches cruise traffic that is still a clear cross in the sky.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between requests to Flightradar24. Thirty is smooth without asking much of a service that is doing this for free.
data_description.max_flights: Only the nearest are kept. The card filters again on what you can see and hear, so this is just a ceiling on the size of the sensor.
data_description.details: One extra request per new aircraft, cached until it leaves. Without it the card shows B738 instead of Boeing 737-800 and has no photograph.

abort.already_configured: That position is already being watched.
